Sandbox_CellFridgeCapacity_tooltip:
How much weight the fridge compartment of the Cell Fridge can hold.
B42 measures container capacity in kilograms, and the engine caps a placed container at 100 kg.
Applied when the fridge is built.

How much weight the freezer compartment of the Cell Fridge can hold.
B42 measures container capacity in kilograms, and the engine caps a placed container at 100 kg.
Applied when the fridge is built.
